title: Desk Guidance on Extensions, Overstays and Early Departure (Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement)
content:
The planned departure date of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement can move later by an extension, and the nights actually stayed are settled at check-out. The rules in force are set out below.

## Retired provision

The former provision that an extension moves the planned departure date later at the guest's request and is charged as an extension segment of the added nights at the locked nightly rate is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

## Rules in force

**Request cutoff.** An extension must be requested no later than the extension request cutoff of the stay type before the planned departure date. The cutoff is counted in calendar days back from the planned departure date, so the last day to request is the planned departure date minus the cutoff in calendar days, inclusive. The planned departure date read is the one recorded on the stay.

**Limits.** A stay may be extended at most the maximum extensions of the stay type, and its total nights including extensions may not exceed the maximum stay of the stay type; extensions may be recorded only while the stay is in booked or in-stay status.

**Check-out.** At check-out the nights stayed are the check-out date minus the check-in date in calendar days. Where the stay type credits unused nights after an early departure and the guest leaves before the planned departure date, the booked nights not used are credited as an early-departure credit referencing the latest charged segment, except that nights are never credited below the minimum stay in total.

**Overstay.** A guest who stays past the planned departure date without an extension is charged the extra nights as an extension segment at the locked nightly rate.

## Nights credited after an early departure

The nights credited are the booked nights less the greater of the nights stayed and the minimum stay, and never fewer than none.

| Hypothetical stay | Booked nights | Minimum stay | Nights stayed | Nights credited |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 21 | 7 | 15 | 21 less 15, that is 6 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 21 | 7 | 4 | 21 less 7, that is 14 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 14 | 14 | 10 | 14 less 14, that is none |

## Request cutoff: boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

For a stay type with a cutoff of 2 days and a planned departure on 20 May, the last day to request is 18 May.

| Extension requested on | Within the cutoff |
|---|---|
| 18 May | Yes — the last day, inclusive |
| 19 May | No |

## Points of judgement

- *A completed stay is asked to be extended.* Extensions may be recorded only while the stay is booked or in stay, so no extension is recorded.
- *A stay already extended the maximum number of times.* No further extension is allowed.
- *A guest leaves a day late with no extension.* The extra night is charged as an extension segment at the locked nightly rate.

superseded_clauses: An extension moves the planned departure date later at the guest's request and is charged as an extension segment of the added nights at nightly_rate_locked.
